mapper.insert: INSERT INTO food_database_candidates (normalized_name, recognized_name, occurrence_count, last_cooking_method, review_status, first_seen_at, last_seen_at) VALUES (#{normalizedName}, #{recognizedName}, 1, #{cookingMethod}, 'PENDING', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE recognized_name = VALUES(recognized_name), occurrence_count = occurrence_count + 1, last_cooking_method = COALESCE(VALUES(last_cooking_method), last_cooking_method), last_seen_at = VALUES(last_seen_at)
